text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed to eu-west-1 (v2026.03.20). Postdeploy smoke tests started. canary=10% :rocket:

sam: Seeing elevated embed synthetic p95 in eu-west-1 — jumped from ~110ms to ~420ms starting around 1758887900. Opening thread.

marta: Thanks — is the spike across all hosts or concentrated on autoscaler-backed instances?

sam: Correlated with autoscaler scale-up events. Two hosts returned 503s for /healthz then recovered. Quick check: `curl -sS -w '%{http_code}' -o /dev/null http://10.4.3.21/healthz` -> `503`.

kevin: Run this synthetic check so we have consistent numbers: `rctl probe synthetic --region eu-west-1 --type embed --percentile p95 --window 5m`

deploy-bot: Synthetic probe results: region=eu-west-1 p95=412ms error_rate=0.8% (threshold 0.5%) failing_hosts=2/20. Probe window ended 1758888060.

jess: Recommend pinning eu-west-1 traffic back to previous stable variant while we investigate. Suggested command: `rctl set-route --region eu-west-1 --variant stable-20260318 --weight 100`

sam: +1. Also drop canary to 0% for eu-west-1 and halt further rollouts.

marta: I'll run diag on the two hosts: `diag autoscaler --hosts 10.4.3.21,10.4.3.22` and collect `dmesg` + container logs. @kevin can you open an incident and assign to eng-releases?

kevin: Incident created INC-20260320-042 and assigned to eng-releases. Applying pin now.

deploy-bot: Route update applied: eu-west-1 -> stable-20260318. Canary halted. Change logged.

oncall-bot: Oncall notified: @mike is assigned. :bell:

mike: Taking this. Watching metrics/traces. If p95 doesn't fall <200ms within 10m, prepare region rollback.

marta: Collected logs show OOM killer activity on host 10.4.3.22 around spike time. Suspect memory regression with new quantized variant. Saving artifacts: /var/tmp/incident-1758888000.tar.gz

sam: Good catch. Also check warmup scripts — KV cache might not be prefilled on new instances causing initial latency spikes.

jess: Adding note to release notes: "Known issue: potential memory/warmup regression in quantized variant; recommend pinning and warmup rerun if seen." cc: @product

kevin: For now pin will stay for 60m while we triage. I'll update INC-20260320-042 with timeline and rollback criteria.

mike: Monitoring update: p95 dropped to 180ms after pin. Immediate user impact mitigated. Keeping ticket open for post-mortem and next steps.

sam: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Audit log: route_change by kevin @1758888120; canary_adjust by kevin @1758888130

-- end of thread --
